test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The total surface area of a solid right circular cone is 6930 cm². Its curved surface area is {4 over 5} its total surface area. What is the diameter (in cm) of the base of the cone? (Take pi = {22 over 7})
solution:
Formula:

Total surface area of solid cone = πr(l + r)

Curved surface area = πr(l + r)

Where "l" and "r" are the slant height of the cylinder and the radius of the cylinder respectively.

Calculation:

According to the question,

Curved surface area is {4 over 5} its Total surface,

⇒ πrl = 4/5 πr(l + r)

⇒ l = 4/5(l + r)

⇒ 5l = 4l + 4r

⇒ l = 4r

Now, Total surface area of a solid right circular cone is 6930 cm2

⇒ πr(l + r) = 6930

⇒ 22/7 × r × (4r + r) = 6930

⇒ 22/7 × r × 5r = 6930

⇒ r² = 63 × 7

⇒ r = 7 × 3 = 21 cm

Diameter = 2r = 2 × 21 = 42 cm.

**∴ The diameter of a cone is 42 cm.**
